name: comp-294
title: App Update Notification
description: A software update notification. A round badge with a circular refresh arrow leads a version headline and short explanation, with a filled Install button, a link-style Later and a close cross.
use: A web app should nudge people toward a new version without blocking their work.
avoid: Every control is decorative: the card cannot be closed, installed or deferred.
a11y: The close button is named and all controls take focus, but none of them has an action attached. (keyboard: partial, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A bordered card with a soft shadow holds a circular outlined badge containing two curved arrows. Beside it a bold version sentence and two muted lines of release notes, then a light Install button, an underlined Later, and a grey X at the top right.
behaves: Hovering shades the Install button and the close cross and underlines Later, but no click is wired: the card never closes and no update starts.
customise: Version line, description and both button labels are written in the file; there are no props and the width cap is fixed in a class.
weight: light: A card with one icon and three simple buttons; only hover fades run.
demo: The line "Version 1.4 is now available!" with a note about bug fixes and performance improvements.
issues: Install, Later and the close cross have no handlers, so pressing any of them does nothing.
polishWhy: Clear hierarchy and tidy spacing; the buttons are the only unfinished part.
